_doc: Per-venue settlement-SLA measurements — the result file of the OPT-IN settlement probe (just swap-venue-probe; sideshift_settlement_sla in crates/dpay-relay/tests/swap_venue_mainnet.rs, DPAY_SIDESHIFT_PROBE_SHIFTS=venue_id=shiftId,...). Each row is the RAW measurement over the venue's own keyless /shifts/{id}: settled (did a payout land), settle_seconds (createdAt→probe-run, an upper bound — the keyless surface exposes no settled-at; run the probe soon after an order settles), measured_at (unix seconds of the probe run). The relay compiles this file in and derives the verdict AT SERVE TIME via catalog::settlement_verdict — degraded = not settled, or settle_seconds > 1800 (30 min, pinned ==1800 in venue_truth_tests) — so probe and reader cannot drift. GET /api/v1/venues attaches the verdict as health and orders degraded rows LAST (the app never ranks; relay order is the demotion). A passing probe run rewrites the row (clearing it); commit + redeploy ships either way. The probe NEVER creates orders (that spends funds — founder rule: measure only real shifts the operator names). Empty venues{} = nothing measured yet: absence is healthy-by-default, never invented.
